[EN] A ring of bodyguards surrounds Orless at all times. They're tough stuff: {@LinkCreature:11#1011#Red Lash petty officers}, {@LinkCreature:11#2008#buccaneers}, and {@LinkCreature:11#4005#overseers}.

Deplete the bodyguard supply, and you make Orless vulnerable. And you simultaneously make sure there's no one to take over when Orless dies.

Bring back their tags. I have an idea...
[ES] Un círculo de guardaespaldas rodea a Orless todo el tiempo. Son tipos duros: {@LinkCreature:11#1011#Red Lash petty officers}, {@LinkCreature:11#2008#buccaneers} y {@LinkCreature:11#4005#overseers}.

Reduce el suministro de guardaespaldas y harás que Orless sea vulnerable. Y al mismo tiempo te asegurarás de que no quede nadie para tomar el mando cuando Orless muera.

Tráeme sus chapas. Tengo una idea...

[EN] That's a lot of tags! I'll pass these out to the lads—they'll get a kick out of it.

Well done, .
[ES] ¡Es un montón de chapas! Se las repartiré a los muchachos; les hará gracia.

Bien hecho, .

[EN] {@LinkCreature:11#1011#Red Lash petty officers}, {@LinkCreature:11#2008#buccaneers}, and {@LinkCreature:11#4005#overseers} guard the captain. Keep them from doing that...by killing them.
[ES] {@LinkCreature:11#1011#Red Lash petty officers}, {@LinkCreature:11#2008#buccaneers} y {@LinkCreature:11#4005#overseers} protegen al capitán. Evita que sigan haciéndolo... matándolos.
